facts: The development of the approach to question answering was motivated by the success of ensemble methods in machine learning and other areas of natural language processing.
A multi-strategy and multi-source approach to question answering was developed.
The approach to question answering is based on combining the results from different answering agents.
Different answering agents search for answers in multiple corpora.
The answering agents adopt fundamentally different strategies.
An answering agent utilizes primarily knowledge-based mechanisms.
An answering agent adopts statistical techniques.
A multi-level answer resolution algorithm was presented.
The answer resolution algorithm combines results from the answering agents.
The answer resolution algorithm combines results at the question level.
The answer resolution algorithm combines results at the passage level.
The answer resolution algorithm combines results at the answer level.
Experiments evaluate the effectiveness of the answer resolution algorithm.
Experiments show a 35.0 % relative improvement over the baseline system in the number of questions correctly answered.
Experiments show a 32.8 % improvement according to the average precision metric.
